description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation facility. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity to oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader committed to fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. This role offers a competitive salary range of $115,000 to $145,000 per year, reflecting the importance of this position and the expertise required. Join a team dedicated to making a significant impact on the lives of residents.
requirements: Current and valid LNHA license in Maryland
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
In-depth knowledge of state and federal regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.

description:
Join a premier diagnostic imaging center as a Remote Radiologist, specializing in Workers Compensation and No-Fault cases. This full-time opportunity allows you to work from anywhere, provided you hold a valid New York State license. We are seeking a dedicated professional who can contribute to our team, particularly with weekend availability.

This role offers a unique compensation structure, heavily weighted towards bonuses and per-scan rates rather than a traditional salary. You will focus exclusively on Workers Compensation and No-Fault cases, as we do not work with major medical insurances, Medicare, or Medicaid. This is an urgent opening for an experienced radiologist ready to make an immediate impact.
requirements: Current New York State Radiologist license
Demonstrated experience with Workers Compensation and No-Fault (NF) cases
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is heavily bonus-driven, with per-scan rates of $50 for MRI, $30 for CT, and $10 for X-Ray. This role is less focused on a traditional salary structure. Experience in Workers Compensation or No-Fault/Lien cases is essential.
